scientific_integrity: Exact finite family and all-size combinatorial proof; computational checks support but do not replace proof. No claim of independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Individually named near-transitive tournament bases with exactly one reversed arc; the entire family of arbitrary bases is not classified.
Original 1972 one-point-extension paper was not available in full; priority beyond inspected texts remains provisional.
title: A sharp prime-one-type law for a single reversal in a transitive tournament
